title: Step 29 dimension-four allocation and twist-spike audits
scope: Execution checks for the positive-collapse Bochner route; not a proof/refutation of Yau-26.

nilpotent_lie_algebras_dim_le_3: dim 3: abelian or Heisenberg H3 with [e1,e2]=b e3, e3 central
dim4_nilpotent_allocation.consequence: In dimension four, Step-28's center Bochner bound controls every nilpotent fibre bracket; no central-quotient induction or quotient pointwise Ricci bound is needed for the fibre-bracket part.
dim4_nilpotent_allocation.bochner_bound_symbolic: if <b^2>_{|Z|^2} <= 2K then all H3 brackets are L2-bounded by 2K
dim4_nilpotent_allocation.limitation: This is weighted L2 control for exact/almost central Killing fields; it is not pointwise control and it does not by itself construct an Einstein metric.

interpretation_of_solution.base_2jet: pa,pc are O(B^2) and make the base Ricci absorb the horizontal twist/Hessian spike.
interpretation_of_solution.arbitrary_twist: B^2=S is a free parameter; total Ric_g(0)=Lambda g(0) for all S once the base/dilaton 2-jets are chosen.
interpretation_of_solution.small_dilaton_spike_scaling: On a ball of radius r<<1/S, a bump with Hessian H=O(S) has ||u||_C0=O(S r^2) and ||du||_C0=O(S r), both tending to 0 while |F|^2=S tends to infinity.
interpretation_of_solution.consequence: Pointwise |phi|^2 cannot be forced by the algebraic KK Ricci equations or by a naive Moser argument that lacks full-curvature/Sobolev control; the accessible quantity should be integrated Bochner/scale comparability.

noncentral_left_invariant_field_H3.consequence: Noncentral directions have |L_X g|~|b| at unit length, so the almost-Killing correction is the same order as the bracket term; they cannot replace the central Killing direction in the Bochner argument.

research_conclusion: In dimension four, nilpotent collapse fibres have dimension at most 3 and are 2-step, so the Step-28 center bound controls all fibre brackets in weighted L2 once a central Killing/almost-Killing field exists.
The quotient-induction horizontal-twist pointwise problem is therefore not the crux for the four-dimensional positive branch; it first matters for higher-dimensional multi-step fibres.

A direct symbolic KK jet computation exhibits arbitrarily large pointwise connection curvature with total Ricci exactly Lambda at a point after adjusting a small-dilaton Hessian and base Ricci 2-jet. This supports abandoning pointwise |phi|^2 as a target and focusing on integrated Bochner estimates plus collapse-scale comparability/oscillation.

The main positive-branch bridge remains producing central (almost-)Killing fields with scale-correct Lie derivative bounds from C0 Ricci pinching alone; bounded-curvature CFG machinery cannot be assumed because of the Step-11 CZ spike.
